title: AI Ad Creative Testing Tool for Creative Variant Testing and Performance Prediction | GetCrux
summary: Test ad creatives, compare variants, and predict stronger concepts with GetCrux. AI ad creative testing software for Meta, TikTok, Google, BI data, and enterprise paid media teams.
body_markdown:
Test ad creatives, compare variants, score new concepts, and find what to launch next with GetCrux.


GetCrux (getcrux.ai) helps enterprise growth, creative, and performance marketing teams turn creative testing into a repeatable workflow. Connect your ad accounts and source-of-truth performance data, let AI analyze every creative, and see which hooks, messages, formats, visuals, CTAs, creators, and angles are most likely to produce winners.


AI ad creative testing tool to evaluate launched creatives, compare new variants, score pre-launch concepts, and decide which creative variables to test next.


## Test ad creatives with performance data, not guesswork


Most ad creative testing tools stop at dashboards. GetCrux goes deeper: Our AI watches every ad, labels the elements inside each creative, and connects those labels to your actual performance metrics.


- Compare ad creatives by message, hook, format, product angle, creator type, CTA, offer, visual style, audience, and any custom label you define.
- Answer questions like which variants are producing winners, which hooks to repeat, which messages to stop testing, and which ad concepts to launch next.
- See which creative elements correlate with lower CAC, higher ROAS, or stronger downstream performance.


## Creative testing software for enterprise paid media teams


GetCrux is built for teams running high-volume creative testing across Meta, TikTok, Google, YouTube, and other paid media channels: AI ad testing tool and a creative optimization layer to compare creatives across campaigns, channels, audiences, and business metrics.


- Compare creative performance across campaigns and channels
- Test ad variations by hook, message, CTA, format, talent, and concept
- Identify winning creatives and repeatable creative patterns
- Analyze static ads, video ads, carousels, headlines, copy, and CTAs
- Define custom winning criteria by campaign, market, platform, or KPI
- Connect creative results to BI, MMP, attribution, and first-party data sources
- Turn winning patterns into briefs, scripts, and new creative concepts


## AI creative testing that explains why ads win


> The AI Creative Analyzer breaks each ad into testable creative variables, groups similar ads, compares performance, and surfaces actionable patterns.


GetCrux does more than show which ads performed best — it explains what made them different so teams know what to repeat, pause, refresh, or isolate in the next creative batch.


### Examples


- UGC videos with the brand shown in the first five seconds have a higher winner rate.
- Problem-solution hooks outperform feature-led hooks for this campaign.
- Outdoor creator videos are scaling better than studio-shot videos.
- Ads with a direct price objection response perform better for this audience.
- Fear-based messaging is fatiguing faster than trust-based messaging.


Detects fatigue, performance shifts, and recurring winner patterns across campaigns, channels, and historical tests to give a clearer testing system.


## Score pre-launch creatives before spend goes live


Upload or generate new creative concepts and score them against historical winners. GetCrux rates ideas based on similarity to proven patterns, messaging strength, visual structure, engagement signals, and your custom criteria. Use GetCrux' pre-launch creative testing to:


- Prioritize which ads to launch first
- Reduce low-quality creative volume
- Compare new variants before spend goes live
- Check whether new ads match proven winning patterns
- Build stronger test batches before sending creatives to media buying teams


For teams seeking predictive creative testing or a creative performance prediction tool, GetCrux connects new ideas to patterns already working in your account.


## Compare ad creatives across Meta, TikTok, Google, and BI data


GetCrux connects to ad platforms and custom data sources so your creative testing uses the metrics your team actually trusts.


- Connect Meta, TikTok, Google, YouTube, LinkedIn
- Connect BI and analytics: Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI, Looker
- Connect attribution and mobile: AppsFlyer, Northbeam, Triple Whale, Adjust, Singular
- Support custom metrics, attribution models, funnel data, and business-specific KPIs


Cross-channel creative testing: compare the same creative, format, message, or concept across multiple platforms.


## Compare every creative variant by the elements that matter


Test beyond simple A vs B by labeling and comparing creatives across a wide set of variables — and you can add custom AI labels for any hypothesis.


- Hook
- Headline and primary text
- CTA
- Offer
- Message angle
- Product feature
- Visual setting
- Talent or creator type
- Video length and pitch timing
- Static vs video
- Audience persona
- Competitor-inspired concept


Test whether blue backgrounds, founder-led videos, aspirational talent, product shots, region-specific offers, or specific CTA structures work better, GetCrux can label the creative library and compare results.


## Turn creative testing into new ads, briefs, and scripts


Turn test results into action with AI Copilot that generates briefs, scripts, and variant ideas based on what already works.


- Find common elements across winning creatives
- Generate new concepts from proven patterns
- Write scripts based on top-performing hooks
- Create new ad variations from successful creative structures
- Recreate competitor-inspired concepts within brand guidelines
- Recommend fixes for near-winner creatives
- Build a test plan for the next creative sprint

Replace error-prone, manual processes with GetCrux' automated labeling and performance linkage. Say goodbye to

With GetCrux, every creative becomes searchable, labeled, comparable, and connected to performance.

Creative, performance, analytics, and leadership teams have a shared view of what is working through custom dashboards, executive summaries, and historical trend reviews.


- Build custom dashboards and share executive-ready summaries
- Review visual creative patterns while analysts drill into source-of-truth metrics
- Analyze trends across campaigns, channels, brands, and time periods
